Ben / Lauren —

Summary of what we can deliver in this window and a couple of gating notes: 

1) Compliance artifacts (attachable)
- SOC 2 Type II (redacted) — we can provide the report PDF with vendor redactions.
- ISO 27001 certificate — full copy attachable.
- Pen test summary — sanitized executive summary attachable.

2) Technical evidence language (suggested wording for the workbook)
- Tenant isolation: "Customers are provisioned into dedicated namespaces with logical isolation enforced at the orchestration and network layer. No cross-tenant data access is permitted; KV caches and model state are scoped per-tenant."
- KMS / BYOK: "We support customer-managed keys via KMS integrations (AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault, GCP KMS). Keys are used for at-rest encryption of model artifacts and sensitive logs. For Azure Marketplace, BYOK process requires a short form attestation and KMS key ARN."
- Logging & audit: "Audit logs (auth, admin, request traces) retained by default 90 days; extended retention options available per contract. We can provide an export of request traces for audit purposes under NDA."

3) Marketplace-specific notes
- AWS: metering model — token-based metering maps to AWS usage metering; we'll supply a sample metering manifest and recommended SKU mapping.
- Azure: listing requires a short "solutions template" describing resource group isolation and optional VM-level private endpoints. We can supply a template and diagram (see Azure-marketplace-evidence.zip).
- GCP: billing exports — we can deliver a BigQuery export pattern for usage events for customers who want direct ingestion.

Gating items: we should confirm whether Glyph requires unredacted SOC 2 for procurement or if a redacted copy + SOC letter suffices. Also need to know if they require a jump-start private deployment (on-prem/package) in the scope of listing.

Attachments: Azure-marketplace-evidence.zip (contains diagrams, template, and public listing copy)

Monica Patel
Head of Security & Compliance (interim) | Redwood Inference
